title: Setting Up Claude
description: Create your Claude account, understand the free and paid plans, and prepare your workspace for effective use.

data.text: Getting started with Claude is straightforward. You can sign up using an email address or through Google or Apple authentication. The web app is available at claude.ai, and mobile apps are available for iOS and Android. No credit card is required for the free tier.

Claude offers both a free tier and a paid Claude Pro subscription. The free tier is genuinely useful for most everyday tasks and gives you access to Claude's latest model with usage limits. The Pro tier removes most limits, gives you priority access during high-traffic periods, and unlocks longer conversations.

cards.title: Claude Free
cards.description: The free tier is excellent for getting started and regular light use.

cards.title: Claude Pro ($20/month)
cards.description: For power users who need reliable, unlimited access to Claude.
cons: May not be necessary for casual users

data.text: Claude comes in different model sizes, each optimized for different needs. Claude Sonnet is the balanced workhorse — fast, capable, and cost-effective for most tasks. Claude Opus is the most powerful model for complex reasoning, creative tasks, and nuanced analysis. Claude Haiku is the fastest, designed for quick responses and high-volume applications. As a beginner, you will mostly interact with Claude Sonnet.

items.text: Go to claude.ai and sign up with email or Google/Apple
items.hint: Use the method you are most comfortable with
Check your spam folder if you do not see it

items.text: Review the free tier limits in your account settings
items.hint: Look for 'Usage' or 'Plan' in the sidebar

items.text: Start your first conversation with a simple prompt
items.hint: Try: 'Explain quantum computing to me like I'm 12'

items.text: Explore the interface — sidebar, input area, and settings
items.hint: Click around to get familiar before moving to the next lesson

data.text: Claude allows you to set custom instructions that shape how it responds to you across all conversations. These are sometimes called a 'system prompt' — background instructions that tell Claude about your preferences, role, and context. Setting a good custom instruction can dramatically improve the quality of Claude's responses.

data.title: Good custom instruction example
data.content: Custom instruction: 'I am a marketing manager at a B2B SaaS company. When I ask for content, write for an audience of CTOs and IT directors. Use a professional but approachable tone. When I ask for code, use TypeScript and follow Airbnb style guidelines.'

data.title: Start with a simple custom instruction
data.text: Even a basic custom instruction like 'I prefer concise responses' or 'I am a student studying biology' will noticeably improve Claude's outputs. You can always refine it later as you learn more about what works for you.

data.title: Setup complete
points: Claude has a generous free tier with no credit card required
Claude Pro ($20/month) adds priority access and higher limits
Claude Sonnet is the default model you will use most often
Set a custom instruction to improve responses across all conversations
